_name: Unknown tool refuses the whole scenario
_purpose: A step naming a tool that does not exist is refused before anything runs, and the refusal names the step. There is no invocation to build, so this is the one failure a scenario reports on the call rather than on a step - which is exactly why it needs a file of its own.
_reading: The run_scenario call itself must come back refused, with zero steps reported. A scenario that runs its other steps and skips this one would be worse than useless: it would leave a typo'd tool name silently doing nothing in the middle of a suite that reported green.
_history: This assertion used to sit as the third step of 04-refuses-bad-input.json, where it aborted that file at parse time so the two steps above it never ran - while the harness counted the empty result as one step correctly refused. Alone in its own file, the abort is the assertion.
